_about: Reference screenshots (1920x1080, lossless WebP = pixel-exact) for testing the bot offline: scripts/ui_probe.py runs the bot's real detection code on a frame, scripts/loot_eval.py scores the loot reader on every frame with a 'loot' entry. Folders are named after the CoC UI they show; capture new ones with scripts/capture_frame.py and describe them here.

old_ui_2026-07/attack_3.webp.screen: Attack scouting screen, pre-update UI, candy scenery

coc_18.647_2026-11/popup_welcome_back.we.screen: 'Welcome Back Chief!' popup on game start. The bot's click_exit (tap 0.99,0.99) dismisses it without opening Build; the 'okay' template only scores 0.63 here

coc_18.647_2026-11/home.webp.screen: Home village. Builder (0/7) and lab (1/2) counters moved from top-center to bottom-right above Build; utils.read_counter reads them at HOME_BUILDER_COUNTER / HOME_LAB_COUNTER. Gold 9 388 101, elixir 13 935 650; the resource bars now fill from the icon leftwards (storage = amount / capacity; both capacities are ~25.75M (4 storages + Town Hall), fitted from the two home frames)

coc_18.647_2026-11/popup_builders_busy_g.screen: Confirm pressed on a wall's upgrade dialog with every builder busy (0/7): 'All builders are busy! Nothing is spent until that button is pressed; one corner tap (click_exit) closes the popup. assets/upgrader/builders_busy.png is its title (1.0 here, <=0.39 on every other frame); Upgrader._builders_busy closes it.
